title: Structure-Preserving Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Dissipative Dynamics: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Standard neural ODEs violate thermodynamic entropy production constraints when simulating open physical systems. We introduce a GENERIC-compliant neural ODE parameterization that explicitly partitions dynamics into reversible Hamiltonian and irreversible dissipative brackets. Long-term simulations of turbulent Couette flow demonstrate bounded phase-space drift below 2.1e-5. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 3.1x and a verified task accuracy of 99.4% with mean execution latency of 6.8ms.
